subject: [PATCH v3 10/18] selftests/mm: add order-parameterized khugepaged collapse cases

2026-08-12.patch_summary: This patch adds four new test cases to the selftests/mm/khugepaged context, which checks how Memory Transparent Huge Pages (mTHP) collapse works at different orders. The new cases focus on detecting which aligned window collapses and which of its neighbors does not, providing more detailed information about mTHP behavior. Each case faults a region before MADV_HUGEPAGE with only the target order enabled, ensuring that the sources are always order 0 and the collapse product can only come from khugepaged. The test cases wait for a full pass rather than waiting for the result to appear, allowing for more accurate testing of mTHP behavior.
